competitor_analysis.positioning_decision: Y*Bridge Labs should not position as a broker, filing service, or legal advisor. The wedge is a fast cash-decision brief that tells the importer what questions to ask, what margin scenarios to model, and whether to pursue a licensed partner.

outputs: decision brief with no legal/customs advice disclaimer

go_to_market_plan.first_message_hypothesis: Would a 48-hour tariff margin rescue brief help you decide which SKUs need price changes, supplier changes, refund/protest review, or broker questions before your next shipment?

market_definition.job_to_be_done: protect gross margin and cash planning when import duties, landed cost, and refund/protest options change faster than the importer can analyze
not_the_market: enterprise global trade management platform replacement
why_now: tariff volatility turns import decisions into immediate margin and pricing problems
SMB importers often lack in-house trade compliance teams
refund/drawback/protest opportunities create found-money urgency but also complexity

longer_term_moat: partner network with brokers/refund providers if validated
near_term_moat: clear boundary between analysis and licensed filing
moat_and_differentiation.not_a_moat: generic AI writing, generic tariff lookup, or broad AI governance language

entry_offer.name: 48-hour Tariff Shock Margin Rescue Brief
entry_offer.why: small enough for urgent owner approval; high enough to test real willingness to pay

premium_offer.name: 30-day Tariff Desk with weekly SKU/supplier scenarios
premium_offer.why: only after first sprint proves repeat urgency

offer_and_pricing_hypotheses.success_fee_boundary: Do not offer contingency refund filing unless licensed partner boundary exists.

product_strategy.not_a_product_yet: No SaaS or autonomous client-facing rescue agent should be built before L4 feedback.
